outline:
積層製造(3D列印)加工原理、積層製造系統分類、加工參數與加工結果分析，製程設備研究，快速模具技術研究，積層製造與快速模具實習，專題研究與討論。

This course includes the principle of additive manufacturing process, classifications, process parameters, and the systems. The application of additive manufacturing will also introduce together with practice works. Two mini projects need to complete during this semester.
